pubDescription: A big thank you to everyone who makes this community come alive.
pubSoonTitle: The thank-you wall is getting ready
pubSoonText: Come back in a moment: it will be filled soon.
pubEmptyTitle: The wall is filling up soon
pubEmptyText: The first people to thank are on their way.
suggestReason: keeps your people, their photos and their categories (the thank-you wall needs it)
adminNoBook: The Contacts module is missing: the thank-you wall reads its people there.
adminNoRight: You can see the wall but not change it. Ask the person who manages the site.
adminUnready_no_category: There is no category in Contacts yet. Open the Settings tab, type the name of the group to thank (for example “Moderators”) and click “Create”.
adminUnready_choose: In the Settings tab, choose the Contacts category to thank.
adminUnready_gone: The chosen category no longer exists in Contacts. Choose another one in the Settings tab.
adminUnready_unverified: Contacts could not confirm the chosen category. Try again in a moment.
adminSlow: Contacts is not answering right now. The public wall keeps the last known content; try again in a while.
adminStale: Contacts is not answering: the public wall shows the last known content.
adminPartial: Some groups could not be read again: the public wall keeps their last known content.
adminHideGone: The chosen “Do not show” category no longer exists: nobody is hidden. Choose another one in the Settings tab.
adminGroup_gone: The category of group {n} no longer exists: this group is not shown. Choose another one in the Settings tab.
adminGroup_duplicate: Group {n} uses the same category as another group: it is not shown twice.
adminTruncated: A group has more than {max} cards: only the first {max} are shown.
adminWallEmpty: Nobody to show yet. Put cards in the chosen category from Contacts: they appear here within a few minutes.
adminHideHow: To not show someone: in Contacts, put her card in the “{category}” category. She disappears from the wall within two minutes. People hidden right now: {hidden}.
adminHideNone: So that a person can ask not to appear: in Contacts, create a category named “Do not show” (or choose one in the Settings tab), then put her card in it. She disappears from the wall within two minutes.
honorIntro: Put one person in the light: she appears large at the top of the wall during the chosen month. You can prepare the next months in advance.
honorNone: Nobody is in the spotlight yet.
honorSearchHelp: Type at least two letters of the name, as in Contacts. Example: Sophie.
honorSearchNone: No card matches. Check the spelling, or create the card in Contacts.
honorMonthHelp: The month during which the person is at the top of the wall.
honorMonthReplace: Someone is already in the spotlight this month: your choice replaces them.
honorWhyHelp: Optional. A little word shown under the name ({max} characters at most). Example: Always there to welcome newcomers.
honorGoneBanner: This card no longer exists in Contacts.
errSearchShort: Type at least two letters. Example: Sophie.
errMonth: Choose a month from the list.
errTooLong: This text is too long ({max} characters at most). Shorten it.
errSave: Saving did not work. Try again in a moment.
errTooMany: You reached the maximum of {max} messages. Remove one before adding another.
msgIntro: Write a short message under a person's name ({max} characters at most). It is kept here, tied to her card: it follows the card if it is merged and disappears if it is deleted.
msgAside: Messages waiting (people not on the wall right now): {n}.
msgFieldHelp: {max} characters at most. Leave empty to remove the message. Example: Thanks for always having a joke for the chat!
tidyIntro: If a card was merged with another one in Contacts, or deleted, this button makes your messages and spotlights follow it, or removes those of a deleted card.
tidyDone: Done. Merged cards followed: {followed}. Deleted cards cleaned up: {removed}.
tidyNothing: Everything is in order: nothing to change.
